summary: The test suite covers core functionality well (parsing JUnit/JSON, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown generation, workflow structure, actionlint validation). Unit tests in TestResultsAggregator.Tests.ps1 exercise the main aggregation logic; Workflow.Tests.ps1 validates workflow structure; Run-ActHarness.ps1 provides integration testing through act with three representative cases. Gaps: limited edge case coverage (special characters, file encoding, permissions, boundary conditions), missing CLI error scenario tests (-FailOnTestFailure behavior), no tests for GitHub Actions environment integration (GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY handling), and only three act test cases. Uses shared $script: variables across tests, introducing minor coupling. Would catch most common regressions but miss subtle edge cases and error path bugs.
